entrypoint: OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m swarm.cli mission run --goal <audit> --model gemma3:4b --repo <this checkout>
expected_output_contract: mission report with issue references, isolated worktree diff if patched, test/check result, cost USD 0
goal: Audit the current SwarmAI subsystem at src/swarm/db/token_hash.py and its call sites for one real correctness, reliability, or security defect. Inspect the actual repository, identify one defensible issue with file/symbol evidence, propose a minimal patch only in an isolated worktree, add or update a regression test, run the relevant check, and submit for review. Do not modify or merge the primary checkout. Do not use demo fixtures or known-answer substitution.
